explication: mobile_scanner is a Flutter plugin that turns camera frames or supported image inputs into barcode results. The principal workflow is app code configuring and starting the scanner, the platform implementation acquiring frames and decoding supported formats, then delivering results to Flutter for display or handling. The graph also preserves documented camera controls, scan-window/image features, and web detection backends. Native implementation links are based on the source index and excerpts; Dart and web internals are represented at their documented boundaries where source excerpts were unavailable.
